overview.title: MBM IdeaX 2025: Overview
overview.description: MBM IdeaX 2025 is the third iteration of the flagship hackathon by the MBMC IT Club, bringing together creative minds to develop impactful solutions using cutting-edge tech. This year, the event focuses on sustainable, industry-aligned projects leveraging AI, blockchain, and decentralized systems. The event aims to foster innovation, collaboration, and entrepreneurship in Nepal's tech ecosystem.

fields.name: Mission
fields.value: Drive positive change through financially viable, innovative solutions.

fields.name: Who Can Join?
fields.value: Students, tech enthusiasts, and interdisciplinary innovators.

themes.title: Event Themes
themes.description: Explore the official themes for MBM IdeaX 2025:

fields.name: 1. Travel and Tourism
fields.value: Innovations for travel planning, sustainable tourism, and virtual experiences.

fields.name: 2. Healthcare and Accessibility
fields.value: Solutions for telemedicine, assistive technologies, and health monitoring.

fields.name: 3. Fin-tech
fields.value: Projects in mobile payments, financial literacy, and blockchain finance.

fields.name: 4. Agro-tech
fields.value: Precision farming, smart irrigation, and agricultural drones.

fields.name: 5. Cultural Preservation
fields.value: Tech for preserving, promoting, and sharing cultural heritage.

fields.name: Note on AI
fields.value: AI can be integrated into any theme for enhanced impact.

timeline.title: Event Timeline
timeline.description:
MBM IdeaX 2025 features a multi-stage program with workshops, registrations, and hackathon rounds.

📍 **ML Workshop:** Jul 21 to Aug 1
📍 **IdeaX Registration Opens:** Jul 21
📍 **Internal Ideathon Registration:** Aug 10 to Aug 26
📍 **Internal Ideathon:** Aug 29
📍 **IdeaX Registration Closes:** ~~Sep 16~~ Oct 4
📍 **IdeaX Online Round:** After Dashain - Dates to be announced
📍 **IdeaX Final Hackathon:** To be Announced

fields.name: Final Dates
fields.value: All dates to be coordinated with academic calendars. Stay tuned for updates!
